detail.longDescription:
To help manage these issues they've done a bunch of work (including upstreaming some of these features to KEDA):

They implemented duardrails for scale
    - scale is matched blue/green during deployments
    - guardrails around config (scale to 0 only for allowlist; critical paths min_replicas ≥ 3)
    - There is an open-source pod-deletion-cost controller!  This is exciting news to me, I want to know what it is
